g.text: US108 — One simulation step: semaphore lock-step (detail)
Before step N: children are waiting on "step start".
active_flights = how many flights take part in this step.
write step number N and simulation time;
write how many flights are active;
read step number, time, and step duration
compute new position for this step
signal: this flight finished step N
wait until flight reports step complete
increase simulation clock by one step;
Step N complete. Parent starts step N+1\nwith new "step start" signals.
